chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Abān, from Salamah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, from his father عليه السلام, that ʿAlī عليه السلام said:
If a man is found with a woman in a single covering, each one of them is to be flogged one hundred lashes.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man involved in the case
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman involved in the case
key_terms.جُلِدَ: was flogged; subjected to corporal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām for a man and a woman found together under one blanket?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning a man and a woman found together under one covering. It belongs to the chapter on the legal penalties related to zina and indicates a punitive ruling for this compromising situation.
